behaviors.description: Preserve native bundle contents when an OCI signing home is supplied.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent native bundle input, controlled origin URL and empty selected keyring directory.
behaviors.expected: Native bundle creation still produces the exact installable commit and origin. This does not establish OCI signing key selection.

behaviors.description: Preserve ordinary metadata updates when a delta worker count is supplied without delta generation.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent repository and controlled public metadata values; no generate-static-deltas request.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary metadata and ref queries remain correct. No worker concurrency or throughput effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Keep OCI lookaside configuration inactive for a native OSTree remote added with that option.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent native branch-selection repository and monitored unused lookaside URL.
behaviors.expected: Exact branch/default changes and deployments remain correct and no lookaside request occurs. OCI signature retrieval is not established.

behaviors.description: Keep modified OCI lookaside configuration inactive for native OSTree operations.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent native branch-selection repository and monitored unused lookaside URL.
behaviors.expected: Branch/default changes and exact deployments remain correct without lookaside traffic. OCI signature retrieval is not established.

behaviors.description: Exercise explicit default-system selection through vendor install/remove/reinstall synchronization.
behaviors.preconditions: Disposable competing stores and independently prepared app/runtime vendor definitions.
behaviors.expected: Explicit system synchronization installs, removes and reinstalls the designated app while preserving runtime and competing stores. The selector equals this command's default.

mappings.rationale: The selected keyring does not apply to the native unsigned bundle path, whose ordinary outputs are fully checked.
